answer: In this PoA design, bonded escrows tie each identity to capital that can be slashed for equivocation. When k identities coordinate the same offense, correlated-evidence penalties grow as O(k²), making a swarm costlier than isolated misconduct. Detection also triggers a compounding haircut across linked escrows, so aggregate capital loss carries an exponential multiplier. A summit of lotus validators may look diverse, but shared equivocation leaves an umber trail.
